new_findings_that_constrain_the_design.detail: pyobject_read_handler uses a BARE except returning -1. A broker that RAISES past a ceiling does not fail loudly — the process HANGS (reproduced; had to be killed at 12s). Ceilings must be enforced by returning a premature EOF (b''), which does produce a prompt ReadStatError on both SAV and DTA. Any implementation that enforces budgets by raising inside read() is unsafe.
a naive object exposing read/seek with raw semantics fails with 'Unable to seek within file'; the seam requires correct tell() semantics.

read_file_in_chunks re-invokes the read function per chunk and does not reset position, so a single reused broker fails on the second invocation. A fresh broker per reader invocation yields correct chunk semantics and complete accounting.
usecols changes only the returned frame; physical reads and bytes are IDENTICAL with and without it on both SAV and DTA at 4000 rows.

findings.no_equivalent_restriction_elsewhere: CONFIRMED — no consumer layer supplies a selected-column physical restriction; downstream selected-variable exactness constrains USE, not READ
findings.pyreadstat_supports_a_usecols_style_rest: YES, and read_file_in_chunks forwards it — but it is a PROJECTION, not a physical read restriction (measured I/O identical)
findings.owner_missing_or_operation_missing: THE OPERATION ITSELF IS MISSING. The frozen expectation is a BOUNDED_FRESH_PHYSICAL_SELECTED_VARIABLE_READ with expected_selected_reads=1 and expected_full_reads=0; the executed route performs a full-column read and zero selected reads. Instrumenting the existing operation would faithfully count the wrong operation.
findings.material_pre_live_gap: YES — affects SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 (three of eight sources), would violate expected_full_reads=0, and the contract treats such a mismatch as a STOP rather than a reportable variance

part_B_selected_read_verdict.honest_nuance: Even with usecols added, pyreadstat 1.3.6 would not reduce physical I/O. An implementation that adds usecols and then claims a physically distinct selected read would be OVER-CLAIMING. Whether the frozen account is satisfied by a projection-filtered full decode (honestly accounted as a full read plus a selection step) or requires a genuinely column-restricted physical read is an AUTHORITY question for HQ; this review does not resolve it.
